brief.text: Good morning Jebin! Monday, Oct 19. Nothing on the calendar today — a clear day. Open time is gold: push the $2,500/day goal one step and get your workout in. Small wins daily, big wins soon.

workout.text: Mon Oct 19 workout: AM upper+abs - floor press 3x10, rows 3x10/arm, shoulder press 3x10, curls 3x10, triceps 3x10, dead bugs 3x8/side. PM legs+abs - goblet squats 3x12, RDLs 3x10, glute bridges 3x15, calf raises 3x15, plank 3x40s, Russian twists 3x12/side.

next.text: Next up: Thu Oct 22 — Katy's flight home from Calgary lands 2:15pm. Nothing on the calendar before then. Enjoy the open stretch.
